text:
emma: heads up — starting a soft release window for model-routing-v3 now. plan: adaptive pinback + soft-eject on error spikes. want quick checklist: thresholds, immediate pin criteria, rollback commands. who’s oncall? :eyes:

deploy-bot: scheduled release window queued for model-routing-v3. to start use `/deploy start --ff model_route_v3 --ramp 10,50,100 --slo-errors 1.5%`

pranav: propose: initial canary 10%, soft-eject if 5xx > 0.75% over 5m, fallback pin to v2 at 100% if persistent for 10m. keep auto-drain to 20% after 5m stable.

troy: +1 on canary. note: for session-affecting requests i prefer immediate 100% pin to v2 rather than soft-eject. soft-eject is fine for stateless endpoints.

ops_sam: add cache TTL bump during ramp to avoid sticky sessions from skewing metrics. also add incident channel to alerts (#incidents) and page if >1% sustained.

emma: adding to release notes now: "model-routing-v3: adaptive rollout with soft-eject policy; automatic pinback to v2 on sustained error/latency regressions." will paste config below.

pranav: config snippet (for ops runbook):
```yaml
feature_flag: model_route_v3
ramp_percent: [10, 50, 100]
eject_policy:
  soft_eject_threshold: 0.75%   # 5xx over 5m triggers soft-eject to avoid user-visible degradations
  sustained_window: 10m         # sustain to escalate to full pin fallback
  pin_fallback_version: v2
  pin_percent_on_escalation: 100
  auto_drain_after_stable: 20%  # reduce to this if system stable for 5m
monitoring:
  error_metric: agent.api.5xx_rate
  latency_p95_threshold_ms: 200
  alert_channels: ["#incidents", "pager"]
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started. Canary at 10% scheduled (canary_ts=1714509900). Monitor via `/metrics query agent.api.5xx_rate --window 5m --ff model_route_v3`. Will post updates.

troy: I’ll watch infra and p95. hold ramp if latency p95 > 200ms or error spike.

ops_sam: if we need to pin manually: `/ff pin model_route_v3 --to-version v2 --percent 100 --reason "auto-pin after spike"` — this will both route and set rollout state.

pranav: also agree on 5m cool-down after a soft-eject before attempting to re-ramp. alerting rule should include a retrigger suppression to avoid noisy flips.

emma: my quicknotes: release notes updated, rollback doc linked (internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rr-model-route-v3), preflight checks green. tagging @troy @pranav ops. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary at 10% completed, no critical alerts in the 5m window. scheduling ramp to 50% in 10m (ramp_ts=1714510500).

troy: looks stable from infra side. happy to proceed with 50% ramp when the bot kicks it.

emma: ok proceeding. reminder: if we see soft-eject engaged, log the reason and add to the release notes for the postmortem.

deploy-bot: Note: automatic soft-ejects will create an annotation in the rollout history. Use `/rollout history model_route_v3` to inspect.

pranav: agreed — if escalation happens we follow runbook: pin -> notify customers -> postmortem.

ops_sam: leaving a watch for 30m after final ramp. ping here if anything odd.

emma: thanks team — keeping this thread as source-of-truth for the rollout. :rocket:
